quarter.zh: 2027 财年第三季（10 月季度）

en: Revenue of $115.8B (+103%) beat the $108B guide and about $109B expected, with data center at $107.6B (+110%) as Vera Rubin NVL72 systems shipped; non-GAAP EPS was $2.68 vs about $2.48. The Q4 guide of $130B (14 weeks, no China data center sales) topped about $125B, and interim CEO Colette Kress lifted fiscal 2028 growth to about 75% from 70%. She sees gross margin bottoming at 71–72% in Q4 before price rises, said China shipments have stopped, and promised a more selective approach to financing customers.

Shares rose as much as 4–5% after hours as the beat landed and the board ruled out reinstating Jensen Huang, and opened near $159 on Wednesday. The gains faded and the stock closed down 2.9% at $150.96, a fifth straight loss and its lowest close in over a year, even as AMD (+5.3%) and Broadcom (+3.6%) rallied. Investors focused on the open-ended CEO search and Kress's tighter stance on the customer financing Huang had championed.
zh: 营收 1,158 亿美元（+103%），高于 1,080 亿美元指引及约 1,090 亿美元的市场预期；数据中心营收 1,076 亿美元（+110%），受益于 Vera Rubin NVL72 系统出货；非 GAAP 每股收益 2.68 美元，预期约 2.48 美元。第四季指引 1,300 亿美元（14 周，不含中国数据中心销售），高于约 1,250 亿美元的预期；临时 CEO 科莱特·克雷斯将 2028 财年增长预期由 70% 上调至约 75%。她预计毛利率在第四季于 71–72% 见底、随后靠提价回升，表示对华出货已停止，并称将更审慎地为客户提供融资。
财报超预期且董事会排除让黄仁勋复职后，股价盘后一度上涨 4–5%，周三开盘约 159 美元。涨幅随后消退，收盘下跌 2.9% 至 150.96 美元，连跌五日，创一年多来最低收盘价；同日 AMD（+5.3%）和博通（+3.6%）走强。投资者关注的是没有时间表的 CEO 遴选，以及克雷斯对黄仁勋力推的客户融资转趋收紧的立场。

bio.en: Named interim CEO on Nov 12, 2026, after co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and left the board; she stays CFO while the board searches inside and outside for a permanent chief. Former Synopsys CEO Harvey Jones became Nvidia's first independent chair.
bio.zh: 2026 年 11 月 12 日联合创始人黄仁勋辞去 CEO 并退出董事会后，被任命为临时 CEO；在董事会从内外部物色正式人选期间，她继续兼任 CFO。前新思科技 CEO 哈维·琼斯出任英伟达首位独立董事长。

bio.en: CFO since 2013 and, from Nov 2026, also interim CEO. Spent nearly 25 years in finance at Cisco, Microsoft and Texas Instruments before joining Nvidia.
bio.zh: 2013 年起任 CFO，2026 年 11 月起兼任临时 CEO。加入英伟达前在思科、微软和德州仪器从事财务工作近 25 年。

sources.t: Why the stock fell after the beat (Seoul Economic Daily)
